name: Sign in and reach the funded recurring workspace
description: Verifies an authenticated player reaches the private dashboard and sees recurring obligations.
steps: Choose Sign in and complete authentication as Actor A
expected: Actor A sees Total money, Unallocated, Quest allocations and Recurring Obligations.

name: Edit a quest and adjust its target without losing allocated money
description: Verifies metadata changes are separate from financial changes and a target increase retains the existing allocation.
setup: Create a quest named Car Fund with a KSh 50,000 target
steps: Edit its name to Car Deposit
Refresh the app and reopen the quest
expected: Car Deposit shows a KSh 60,000 target and the existing KSh 20,000 allocation remains intact.

name: Archive a quest only after its allocation is explicitly reallocated
description: Verifies archiving never silently destroys allocated money and the archived quest remains in history.
setup: Create Quest A with a KSh 10,000 target
Create Quest B with a KSh 20,000 target
steps: Move the remaining KSh 10,000 to Quest B
expected: Quest A is archived, Quest B receives the KSh 10,000, and Quest A's history remains visible in Archives.

name: Edit and archive a commitment without erasing its history
description: Verifies commitment metadata can be edited while its reserved balance remains intact and an empty commitment can be archived.
setup: Create a monthly commitment named Rent for KSh 20,000
steps: Edit its name to House Rent
Open it again and choose Archive
expected: House Rent retains its commitment settings and is archived without deleting its activity history.

name: Reject unsafe commitment archive and invalid financial changes
description: Verifies a funded commitment cannot be archived while holding money and invalid target values are rejected.
setup: Create a monthly commitment named Loan for KSh 5,000
steps: Open Loan detail and choose Archive
Observe that archiving is blocked because reserved money remains
Open a quest target adjustment and enter a non-positive target
expected: The funded commitment remains active and the invalid quest target cannot be saved.
